Three steps inside each PQ solver iteration.

Every iteration measures quad diagonal skew, weights competing strips, and blends shared seam displacements.

Per-iteration solver pipeline

Diagonal skew h

Normal d1 × d2 Offset h = ¼ s·n

Measures how far a quad's two diagonals separate along their mutual normal.

Skew distance |2h| equals the shortest distance between diagonals d1 and d2.

Relative error |2h| / avgDiag normalizes twist across different quad sizes.

Alternating pull

Signs (-1)^(k+1) Priority 1 + 4·err

Pushes even corners down and odd corners up along normal n to flatten the quad.

Displacing corners by +/-h along n zeroes out (p0 - p1 + p2 - p3) . n in one step.

Priority weighting focuses solver effort on the most twisted face loops first.

Seam negotiation

220 Shared Verts Damping 0.85

Shared border vertices average the plane pulls of all incident quad strips.

Boundary check vertLoopSets[v].size >= 2 identifies all inter-strip seam vertices.

Coupled averaging converges global skew from 43.55% to under 0.30% mean error.

Why planar quads unroll without shearing.

Once every quad is coplanar, unfolding around shared hinge edges is a pure rigid 2D rotation.

Isometric unfolding & telemetry proof

Best-fit plane

Coplanar Projection Frame (e1, e2)

Projects each quad onto its exact plane so 2D unfolding preserves 3D edge lengths.

Entry hinge vector baseVec = p_BR - p_BL defines local horizontal axis e1.

In-plane axis e2 = normalize(n x e1) points forward along the strip walk direction.

Hinge attachment

Exit-to-Entry Hinge 0.0000% Residual

Each quad hinges onto the previous quad's exit edge like a folded paper ribbon.

Hinge direction dir = normalize(prevTR - prevTL) rotates local (x,y) into global 2D.

Dashed white lines mark internal fold hinges between consecutive quads q_m and q_{m+1}.

Flat strip proof

Welded 2D Strips 24 Developable Loops

All 24 negotiated strips lay flat on the cutting bed with zero seam gaps.

2D PCA angle 0.5 * atan2(2*covXY, covXX - covYY) aligns each strip's major axis.

Exports flat quad strips to Rhino .3dm layers, .OBJ groups, and laser-cut .SVG.
